topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I just found out that my college application essay, the one I poured my heart into, is being used as a model for others. Great, right? All that time, every word, now on display without even a heads-up. They say imitation is the sincerest form of flattery, but this feels more like a cheap trick. I didn’t sign up to be some kind of public example. I bet they’re telling everyone how perfect it is, how it captured everything. Well, it’s not perfect. It was just what I had to say, and I said it my way. Now everyone’s copying it, thinking it’s a ticket to success. Well, it’s not. It’s just mine. And they can’t have it.
